sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, StickMan Rush is a timeless platformer game where you control a stickman character who must navigate through increasingly difficult levels, collecting power-ups and avoiding obstacles to stay alive. The gameplay is simple yet addictive, with an intuitive control system that allows players to move their character left or right using the arrow keys or touch controls. The stickman can jump, double jump, and even slide, making it easier to navigate through tight spaces and avoid deadly pitfalls.

As you progress through the game, you'll encounter various obstacles such as spikes, pitfalls, and moving platforms. Each level presents a new challenge, requiring you to use your skills and reflexes to overcome the hurdles and reach the finish line. The game also features a variety of collectibles, including coins, power-ups, and hidden items, which can be used to unlock special rewards or boosters.

In addition to the main game mode, StickMan Rush also features a daily challenge mode where you can compete with other players to achieve the highest score. This adds a competitive element to the game, making it even more engaging and challenging.
